inNature.about: Games across the park, from tug-of-war and Mölkky to a quiz and a sack race. Groups check in with a host at every stop, win points along the way and follow the scores on the live feed.
inNature.title: Fun in nature
text: Take your Appro outdoors. Fresh air, open green space and games spread across the park: tug-of-war by the trees, Mölkky on the grass, a quiz in the shade.
Put a host at every checkpoint and let teams make their way from stop to stop. They check in with a QR code, play for points and follow the scores on the live feed.

intro: A park is one of the easiest places to bring people together. There's room to move, fresh air and space for everyone, and nobody has to book a venue or pay to get in. An Appro in nature turns an ordinary day outside into a small adventure: your group walks through the park from one checkpoint to the next, and every stop has something new waiting.

There's so much you can do in a park with friends. Pull together in a tug-of-war under the trees, play a few rounds of Mölkky on the grass, race each other in sacks, jump rope, or find out how much your team knows with a quiz in the shade. Add a photo challenge, a picnic stop or a game you made up yourselves. Simple games work best, because anyone can join in, whatever their age, fitness or language.

Games like these are a great way to get to know people. Playing as a team gives everyone something to talk about straight away, so nobody has to search for small talk. Shy people find it easier to join in, new students meet people outside their usual circle, and old friends see a different side of each other. A bit of friendly competition, plenty of laughter and a shared plan for the day are often all it takes for strangers to become friends.

That's why it works so well at the start of a semester, for a class getting to know each other, for a student association welcoming new members, or simply for a group of friends who want to spend a day outside together. When you're ready to plan your own, Bonfiire helps you set up the checkpoints, invite the hosts and keep score, so you can focus on the fun.

steps.title: Find a park
steps.text: Pick a park with open grass, a bit of shade and enough room to spread the games out. Somewhere easy to reach makes it simple for everyone to come along.

steps.title: Mark the checkpoints
steps.text: Choose a spot around the park for each game and add it to your event as a checkpoint. Add a meeting point too, so everyone knows where the day begins.

steps.title: Add checkpoint hosts
steps.text: Ask a friend to look after each checkpoint. Hosts welcome the teams, explain the game and hand out the points.

steps.title: Invite participants
steps.text: Send invites to your class, student association or friends, or share the event so people can join by themselves. Everyone gets their ticket in the app.

steps.title: Meet at the meeting point
steps.text: When the event starts, everyone gathers at the meeting point. Say hello, form the teams and send them off to their first checkpoint.

steps.title: Check in with a QR code
steps.text: At each checkpoint, the host scans a QR code to check people in. Participants can join on their own or as a team, and either way it only takes a second.

steps.title: Play games and win points
steps.text: Every checkpoint has its own game, from Mölkky to a sack race or a quiz. When a team finishes, the host gives them points or a stamp.

steps.title: Announce the winner
steps.text: At the end, bring everyone back together and crown the team with the most points. A small prize and a big round of applause make the moment.

finale.title: Let's start making fun memories in the park with friends.
text: Grab your friends, pick a park and turn an ordinary day outside into a small adventure. Pull together in a tug-of-war, knock down a few Mölkky pins, race in sacks or test what your team knows. Bonfiire sets up the checkpoints, invites the hosts and keeps the score, so you can just enjoy the day.

barCrawl.title: Bar to bar crawl
text: Take the fun into the city, from one lively bar to the next: karaoke at one, darts or beer pong at another, cocktails and a dance-off to finish.
Every bar has a host at the door and a quick QR check-in. Teams collect a stamp at every stop, earn points along the way and see it all on the live feed.

intro: A bar crawl is one of the classic ways to see a city together. Instead of staying in one place, your group moves from bar to bar, and every stop has something new waiting: a different crowd, a different game, a different playlist.

There's plenty to do along the way. Sing your heart out at karaoke, aim for the bullseye at darts, line up a game of pool or beer pong, shout out the numbers at bingo and finish with a dance-off. Mocktails count as much as cocktails, so everyone can join in, whatever they drink.

Games like these make it easy to get to know people. Playing as a team gives everyone something to talk about straight away, new students meet people outside their usual circle, and by the third bar strangers are cheering for each other.

That's why a bar crawl works so well for a student association's welcome event, a class get-together or friends celebrating the end of exams. When you're ready to plan your own, Bonfiire helps you set up the bars as checkpoints, invite the hosts and keep the stamps and scores, so you can focus on the fun.

steps.title: Pick your bars
steps.text: Choose a handful of bars close to each other and decide the order. Add each one to your event as a checkpoint, plus a meeting point so everyone knows where to start.

steps.title: Put a host at every door
steps.text: Ask a friend to look after each bar. Hosts welcome the teams, run the bar's game and hand out stamps and points.

steps.title: Invite participants
steps.text: Send invites to your class, student association or friends, or share the event so people can join by themselves. Everyone gets their ticket in the app.

steps.title: Meet at the meeting point
steps.text: When the crawl starts, everyone gathers at the meeting point. Say hello, form the teams and send them off to their first bar.

steps.title: Check in with a QR code
steps.text: At the door of each bar, the host scans a QR code to check people in, on their own or as a team. It only takes a second.

steps.title: Collect a stamp at every bar
steps.text: Every bar a team visits adds a stamp to their card in the app. Collect them all to complete the crawl.

steps.title: Play for points
steps.text: Karaoke, darts, pool or beer pong: hosts give points for every game, and the live feed shows who's in the lead.

steps.title: Announce the winner
steps.text: At the last bar, bring everyone together and crown the team with the most points and stamps. A small prize and a big round of applause make the moment.

finale.title: Let's start making fun memories, one bar at a time.
text: Gather your crew and hop from bar to bar, with a new challenge waiting at every stop. Throw a few darts, take the mic for karaoke or win the bar quiz for your team. Bonfiire sets up the stops, invites the hosts and keeps the score, so you can just enjoy the crawl.

cityHopper.title: City hopper
text: Mix it all up. Admire the art at a museum, wander through the market, share a meal at a restaurant, play games in the park and raise a glass at the bar.
Each place has a host and a quick QR check-in. Teams collect stamps at the museum, market, restaurant and bar, win points at the park games, and follow it all on the live feed.

intro: A city is full of places you walk past every day without stopping. A City hopper turns them into one big adventure: your group moves across town from a museum to a market, a restaurant, a park and a bar, and every stop has something new waiting.

There's so much to mix in. Find the hidden detail in a painting at the museum, taste your way through the market, share a meal, throw a frisbee or pull a tug-of-war in the park and raise a glass to finish. Pick places that suit your group; there's no wrong way to hop.

Exploring together is a great way to get to know people. Every stop gives the team something new to talk about, exchange students discover the city with locals, and friends find places they never knew were there.

That's why it works so well for welcoming new or exchange students, a class trip around town or friends who want to see their city in a new way. When you're ready to plan your own, Bonfiire helps you set up the checkpoints, invite the hosts and keep the stamps and scores, so you can focus on the fun.
